stock.description: Golden Wheel Tiandi Holdings Company Limited operates as an investment holding firm, primarily focusing on developing commercial and residential real estate throughout Mainland China and Hong Kong. The company's business activities are structured around three main segments: Property Development, Property Leasing, and Hotel Operation. It undertakes the construction and sale of various properties, provides comprehensive property rental services (including leasing its own assets and subleasing rented spaces), and manages hotels. Furthermore, the company develops and operates shopping centers and offers property decoration services. As of December 31, 2021, its land bank amounted to approximately 1,528,843 square meters. Golden Wheel Tiandi Holdings Company Limited was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Nanjing, People's Republic of China.
